transcript: If I were a bird, I would fly freely wherever I wished In the morning I would pass through the forest At noon I would cross the valley And at night I would sleep beside the stars If I had wings, I would soar above the clouds I would not feel constrained by the distance To faraway cities If I were not bound to the ground, I would surely travel wherever the wind carried me Yet now I stand on the earth I am not a bird, I can only imagine Still to imagine is a small form of freedom Looking up at the evening sky, I think if I were a bird How deeply would I admire this sky? Standing on the ground I still look up at the same sky Imagination embraces me instead

segments.text: If I were a bird, I would fly freely wherever I wished
In the morning I would pass through the forest
At noon I would cross the valley
And at night I would sleep beside the stars
If I had wings, I would soar above the clouds
I would not feel constrained by the distance
If I were not bound to the ground, I would surely travel wherever the wind carried me
Yet now I stand on the earth
I am not a bird, I can only imagine
Still to imagine is a small form of freedom
Looking up at the evening sky, I think if I were a bird
How deeply would I admire this sky?
I still look up at the same sky
